name: MLS Projection
aliases: MLS projection via Hermite Point Set Surfaces
definition: An iterative algorithm to project a query point onto a surface defined by a set of input points and normals, fitting a local quadratic function.
summary: MLS Projection is an iterative algorithm that projects points onto surfaces defined by unstructured point sets and normals, distinguished by its reliance on local quadratic fitting rather than global optimization or grid-based marching.
